findings.body: The confirmation digest does not cover the current specification. Applying the repository's established body-only SHA-256 convention—confirmed by reproducing the hash in `docs/specs/ask-measure-comparison-filter.md`—gives `34ebcb2f...` for this document, while this field records `777ba735...`. Because this spec has no `## For the builders` boundary, the approval rule at `AGENTS.md:72-76` covers the whole document. The substantive edits made after confirmation therefore need renewed owner confirmation before the Done-when is met.

findings.body: The prior ambiguity remains: supported answers may span any time window, but the context still binds one unspecified budget batch and outline. Current Ask provenance can include a separate budget batch for each result month (`backend/src/sql/sqlBuilder.ts:219-221`), whose outline snapshots can differ after partial reloads, while the existing statement drill deliberately selects the block-end budget (`backend/src/mis/mis-drill.service.ts:203-206`). Without an equivalent rule here, statement labels and budget-only GL fallbacks can vary by implementation or query order. Specify and bind the authoritative period/batch.
findings.title: Define which outline governs a multi-period answer

findings.body: The contract says the client sends only the context and row key, but the same spec promises transaction results in pages of 100 at line 108 and C3. After the first page, neither field identifies the next page, so the panel cannot request subsequent results without violating the stated request contract. Define a validated page/cursor field as non-authoritative input, or return a signed continuation token.
findings.title: Allow a pagination control in the drill request
